body:
Ross253212 wrote:
{a lot of stuff snipped.)

> Collin's group, the JDL and various leftist groups.  {Editor:  isn't this
> why Teddy came back to Chicago?]  An estimated 7,000 survivors of the
> Holocaust had settled in Skokie. 30,000 of the 70,000 residents were
> Jewish.Many people felt that display of the swastika should be no more
> permissible under the First Amendment than shouting "fire" in a crowded
> movie theater.  [Editor:  Remember, in his manifesto, Ted argues that
> Nazis appears to be a critical element in his hoped for revolution]

Can you quote this? If not, stop misleading people. The Unabomber spends
a good 1/2 of his manifesto talking about the anomie/alienation of
industrial society and the danger of its increased power in the future.
READ THE MANIFESTO. There's NOTHING there to suggest that the Unabomber
wants world rule by a cadre of fascists. It's very clear that he doesn't
want a power structure of any kind. Can you spell A-N-A-R-C-H-I-S-T.
That sentence you quoted about ne0-nazis? "There are growing numbers of
people who in one way or another are rebels against the system: welfare
leeches, youth gangs, cultists, satanists, nazis, radical
environmentalists, militiamen, etc." PARA. 162 in context with a
discussion of how the system is increasing its control over human
beings. 

If this out-of-context quote is to be an endorsement of Nazis, then I'm
the Pope.

btw, it also endorses radical environmentalists, and SATANISTS. Is the
Unabomber a satanist??

> used spray paint. Three people were injured. ***  {Editor:  compare "FC's"
> hatred of "leftists" in the manifesto]

I'm sure FC hated leftists for many other good reasons.

> 
> [Editor:  even though he would later describe his early views as a bit
> immature, don't you think Ted came back to Chicago in late May 1978 to be
> where the action was?  do you think he knew some of Frankie's bunch since
> the early 70s?]

Nope.

> On June 4, 1979 -- less than two weeks after the UNABOMBER's second bomb
> -- someone sent a letter bomb to Frank Collin at his headquarters on W
> 71st Street. A caller to the New York offices of the Associated Press and
> United Press International announced that mail bombs had been sent to
> Nazis across the country. The caller reported that "more are on the way."
> 
> In addition to the bomb sent to Collin, bombs were sent to a former SS
> stormtrooper in New Jersey, to the National Socialist White People's
> Party's ("NSWPP") headquarters in Arlington, VA, a NSWPP headquarters in
> Cicero, Illinois, and Collin's chief propagandist in Lincoln, Nebraska.
> When F.B.I. Agents became aware of the other bombs, they had the police
> bomb unit examine Collin's mail at a Southwest Side post office. The bomb
> had already arrived at Collin's headquarters, however, and the NSPA
> members brought it back to the Post Office.

that's good news. Anyone who bombs a Nazi is a hero to me. What about
you, Ross? whose side are you on? the way you frequently don't
capitalize the word "Jew" reminds me of a Nazi who posts on
alt.society.anarchy.

> wait a minute, the NA symbol is the Yggdrasil, which was the symbol that
> the FBI doesn't want you to know was used by the Unabomber, which is
> symbolized by wood.  Shame on you Teddy.  I thought you were a liberal
> hero, and it turns out you're just a f---ked up jerk like McVeigh, though
> you got a little more style.]

If you bomb Nazis, you have style and you ARE a hero. by the way, Ross,
did it ever occur to you that "wood" symbolizes "trees", and so does the
Ygdrasil symbol? I'm a Tree-worshipping Nature-lover myself, as is
Theodore Kaczynski. If I were to do any environmental activism, I would
probably choose a tree symbol.


> Dulles International Airport outside of Washington, D.C.  [Editor:  a
> bunch of teachers were on board on the way to a convention rather than the
> businessmen who were the professed target of the Unabomber].

I believe even the Unabomber tried to explain that one; he
miscalculated.


> The supposed sender was Enoch W. Fischer, who had a fictitious North Side
> address. In Hebrew, Enoch means "follower," "dedicated" or "believer."
> Enoch was taken up and walked with God. From a cryptic reference in
> Genesis, developed the "Apocalypse of Henoch" (Enoch). Fischer in German
> means "fisherman." A fish is a symbol for Christ, and by extension, for
> Christianity.

Really! I guess almost every German name means something symbolic or
other. Don't forget, as Mr. Una/Zodiac says, "Ted couldn't get a date,
therefore he must be the Zodiac."


> Yet, the symbolism pointing to neo-Nazi sympathies has always been there.
> Press accounts repeatedly point out the bomber's apparent fascination with
> wood.

wood being a nazi symbol? more likely an eco-freak symbol.


> By a letter postmarked from Oakland on April 20, 1995 -- Hitler's
> birthday -- the UNABOMBER wrote a letter to the New York Times offering a
> purported justification for his violence. He argued that the object of his
> group was to destroy the "worldwide industrial system" and break society
> down into small autonomous units. The bomber claims that "FC" stands for
> Freedom Club.
 The attempted use of chaos and anarchy by anti-semites has a
> long tradition dating to the 1950's when George Lincoln Rockwell founded
> the American Nazi Party in Arlington, Virginia.

lots of people use Chaos & anarchy. Artists & musicians too. 

>
> Which brings me to my final point:  even if I don't get the million dollar
> reward, don't I at least get a Pulitzer?  :0)]

Nope. You get a raspberry & a segment next to Mr. "Unabomber/Zodiac".
